error.insufficientHeading: You don't have enough points yet
error.insufficientBody: You still need {amount} to redeem this item. Watch a video or finish another activity to earn more points, then try again.
error.holdbackHeading: Some of your points are temporarily on hold
error.holdbackBody: You actually have enough points to redeem this item, but some were only just earned and are still being checked to prevent fraud. Those points become usable from {unlockDate}.
error.lockExpiredHeading: This price is no longer valid
error.lockExpiredBody: Your price lock expired at {expiredDate}. Prices and availability can change, so we can't continue at the old price. Reload to see the current price.
error.listingUnavailableHeading: This item is no longer available
error.listingUnavailableBody: It just sold out. Try a similar offer in the Store instead.
error.redemptionFailedBody: Something went wrong while processing your redemption. Your points have not been deducted — please try again.

summary.transferableOnce: This voucher can be transferred once to another YourTal user.
summary.balanceCarrying: Any remaining voucher value can still be used on your next transaction.
summary.singleUseForfeit: This voucher is for one transaction only; any unused value is forfeited.
summary.minimumSpendPolicy: This voucher only applies to purchases meeting a set minimum spend.
